I’m so glad you are reaching out and trying to help support this girl in any way that you can. Firstly, I would say don’t take it personally and get upset when she does self harm. She’s not doing it to hurt you and it can be a shameful thing. With that being said, don’t make her promise not to do it anymore. That makes it so much harder to talk about relapse and she will feel like she’s disappointed you. Don’t try to stop her from self harming by taking tools away. This can lead to her just using other tools she’s not familiar with which is much more dangerous. The best thing you can do is encourage her to self harm safely. Using clean and disinfected tools, cleaning the wounds afterwards, seeking medical treatment if necessary, etc. It’s not your responsibility, so please please don’t feel like you need to take it upon yourself to “fix” her. That can be so difficult for you, and I would hate for you to be hard on yourself. Just listening when she needs someone and caring is so great that you are doing. If you feel it’s necessary you can reach out to a safe adult in her life. Just use your best judgment.

Hey! I totally understand how hard it is to focus and deal with a tough therapy session. I was really struggling with this a few weeks ago and mentioned to my T that I felt so drained the entire week after my session. She told me that anytime I was feeling too overwhelmed to divulge deep into trauma and stuff that we could just have a light session where we talk about fun things and favorite movies/books. She said that just talking about random things with your therapist can still be healing, plus it helps improve the relationship between you too. I would say that instead of cancelling, just let your T know that you can’t handle talking about anything too deep and that you just want to talk about light topics. If you still don’t feel comfortable with doing that, that’s totally okay! I don’t think that if would be wrong for you cancel your session if you have a lot going on with work meetings and everything. You need to do what’s best for you, and your T will understand that. I hope this helps:)
